Join SHIELD Lab

Work with us on secure and trustworthy intelligent systems at Southern Illinois University Carbondale.

Open Positions

We are not currently recruiting for funded Ph.D. research assistantships. If you’re interested in contributing to the lab’s research, contact Dr. Shahid to discuss possible ways to get involved.

Applications for Ph.D. Positions

If you are interested in pursuing a Ph.D. with SHIELD Lab at SIU Carbondale, email Dr. Shahid with:

  • A short explanation of what you want to study and why you’re interested in the lab.
  • Your CV, including undergraduate grades and GRE and TOEFL or Duolingo scores, as applicable.

Use Ph.D. Application – Your Name as the subject line.
